data.gender_notes: Neilesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Neilesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Naila', meaning God or divine, and 'Ish', meaning lord or ruler. This name is often given to a child believed to be a messenger of the gods. In Hindu mythology, Neilesh is also the name of the god of the forest and protector of animals. The name Neilesh carries the meaning “God's messenger” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neilesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
